main.name: ask_user
main.label: Ask the owner
main.description: Ask the owner 1 to 4 questions and wait. Each takes 2 to 4 options (label, meaning) or none for a free answer; a typed answer is always offered, so never add one. multiSelect allows several picks. Put a recommended option first, its label ending in "(Recommended)". Only the interactive main session can ask.

description.description: What choosing it means, and its trade-off.

multiSelect.description: The owner may pick several options.
